marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology leaders reported increased capital expenditure targets for AI hardware and cloud data centers, driving gains across semiconductor suppliers while exerting near-term pressure on software margins.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capex spend reinforces strong revenue visibility for upstream hardware vendors, though market focus is rapidly shifting toward tangible ROI on AI enterprise integration.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of margin compression if software monetization fails to scale rapidly enough to match capex expansion.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & China Internet Giants
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw increased volume as top-tier internet firms accelerated share repurchases and reported steady growth in e-commerce and local services revenue.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive buyback programs combined with stabilizing operating cash flows are helping set a structural valuation floor for major HK-listed Chinese tech stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Macroeconomic consumption trends in mainland China and potential new export restrictions on advanced tech hardware.

marketLayer.title: HK High-Dividend & Southbound Inflows
marketLayer.fact: Southbound capital via Stock Connect recorded significant net inflows today, heavily favoring high-yield HK-listed state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in the energy, telecom, and banking sectors.
marketLayer.inference: Institutional capital continues to favor defensive yield-generating assets amid global interest rate uncertainty and currency fluctuation concerns.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Macro interest rate policy trajectories from global central banks affecting the relative attractiveness of dividend yields.
